title: Compositional multi-label context
purpose: Represent simultaneous contextual dimensions without flattening them into one platform label.

expected.semantic_interpretation: Place, social, and weather dimensions coexist independently on one event.
expected.observability: The occurrence is observed; context dimensions are evidence annotations.
expected.opportunity: No opportunity claim is required for this fixture.
expected.time: Phenomenon, observation/result, and ingestion times remain distinct fields.
expected.provenance: Each context dimension can carry its own source list when needed.
expected.raw_derived: Evidence kind is explicit and does not imply a pattern.
expected.lineage: No correction, deletion, or supersession is asserted.
expected.must_not_infer: Do not infer a routine, preference, habit, or pattern conclusion.
